gaps.description: No single v2 authority contract formally assigns ownership among Book, Part, Node and Blueprint registries.
Not every current consumer is registry-led; direct Book I blueprint references remain.
Existing freeze evidence does not yet establish the final per-book and registry-manifest freeze contract.
Legacy B1 identity and current Book II publication ownership are not consistently separated across projections.
Current, compatibility and historical checkers are not yet governed by a single checker manifest.
